source: Lane 3 24-hour window findings (SCRUM-2994 verification, SCRUM-2911, SCRUM-2913, SCRUM-2993, SCRUM-2999). Static code-path verification; runtime + prod confirmation deferred post-train.
claim_labeling: Each capability is labeled measured|asserted|not_asserted per Constitution §1.5. 'measured' = verified this window; 'asserted' = from config/code not runtime-confirmed; 'not_asserted' = explicitly NOT claimed.

anchoring.description: Integrity fingerprint (SHA-256) + network-observed timestamp committed to the production anchoring network (32-byte commitment; file bytes never leave the device).
anchoring.file_format_support: format-agnostic at the chain layer (byte-level hash, no MIME/extension gating)
anchoring.claim_status_detail: measured for PDF/DOCX/image (existing prod anchors); ASSERTED (static code-path, no runtime/prod anchor this window) for audio/video/binary. Nothing was anchored at runtime this window (W4).
anchoring.constraints: Client-side hashing ceiling: fileHasher.ts loads the whole file into browser memory (file.arrayBuffer()) with a 30s timeout; very large media (multi-GB video / hi-res audio) may fail or OOM. Not 'any file, any size'.
not_asserted: authenticity or genuineness of document content
that the signer/author is who they claim to be
content correctness — only that these exact bytes existed at the network-observed time
perceptual/content matching — a re-encoded or re-saved copy of the same audio/image produces a DIFFERENT fingerprint and will not match
anchoring.evidence: src/lib/fileHasher.ts generateFingerprint() hashes file.arrayBuffer() bytes; services/worker/src/chain/signet.ts OP_RETURN = 4B tag + 32B SHA-256 (cap 80B); confirmation-proof.ts asserts only block-header inclusion + network-observed time.

content_extraction.description: On-device OCR / text extraction producing structured metadata (client-side, §1.6).
content_extraction.evidence: src/lib/ocrWorker.ts extractText(): pdf|docx|image/* branches; else UNSUPPORTED_FILE_TYPE. HEIC/TIFF browser-undecodable (SCRUM-2911). No audio/video extraction path exists.

ai_template_reconstruction.description: Gemini-based reconstruction of a structured template from extracted fields.
ai_template_reconstruction.evidence: SCRUM-2999: recent AI-path records persist low_confidence stubs with no template (measured prod: ARK-DOC-GHZG6V _ai_confidence=0.25). Model-SKU drift + low-confidence gate. Fix pending post-train.
not_asserted: current template richness parity with April-2026 records
